overview: The School Committee approved the Fiscal Year 2024 operating budget and the Superintendent’s annual evaluation. A revised bullying prevention policy was tabled until a special meeting in July to allow members more time to review the final document.

items.title: Bullying Prevention and Intervention Policy Update
items.summary: Tabled the first reading of an updated Bullying Prevention and Intervention Policy until July 19th after members requested more time to review the text and debated legal definitions regarding power differentials. A minor amendment to correct a typographical error was approved prior to the decision to table.

items.title: Superintendent Evaluation
items.summary: Approved the 2022-2023 Superintendent evaluation with minor revisions and voted to publish the final document on the district website.

items.title: FY24 Operating Budget
items.summary: Approved the Fiscal Year 2024 operating budget following discussion about the vacancy of the Chief Financial Officer position and the allocation of compensation increases for non-unit employees.

items.title: Executive Session
items.summary: Entered executive session to discuss collective bargaining with Teamsters Local 25, non-unit personnel contracts, and security strategies, without returning to public session.
